# sheety-localization v0.2.2 baseline

This fixture was generated by the `v0.2.2` CLI from the live example Google
Sheet on 2026-09-11. Generation used read-only Sheets access and
`--no-last-modified` so the snapshot stays deterministic.

The backward-compatibility tests use it as an immutable baseline for:

- all 66 localized message values across `en` and `ru`;
- the public runtime exports available in `v0.2.2`;
- legacy soft placeholder interpolation.

Metadata keys beginning with `@` are not value-compared because `v0.3.0`
intentionally adds descriptions and other generated metadata. Update this
baseline only when intentionally choosing a new compatibility starting point.
